fields.title: ～が早いか／～や否や／～なり
fields.notes: Common point: all mean "as soon as...", emphasizing that very little time passes between the two actions.

fields.title: ～そばから
fields.notes: Key point: just after doing something, the same situation occurs again; often expresses repetition and carries a sense of helplessness.

fields.title: ～がてら／～かたわら／～かたがた
fields.notes:
～がてら: do B while doing A.
～かたわら: engage in two activities at the same time over the long term.
～かたがた: "also serving as, while also" in formal situations, often used for visits and greetings.

fields.title: ～をものともせず／～をよそに
fields.notes:
～をものともせず: act without regard for difficulties, generally with a tone of praise.
～をよそに: ignore others' worries or opposition, generally with a tone of criticism.

fields.title: ～に即して／～を踏まえて
fields.notes:
～に即して: handle according to rules, facts, or the actual situation.
～を踏まえて: use existing experience, results, or opinions as the basis for judgment.

fields.title: Three kinds of 「いかん」
fields.notes:
～いかんで: the result depends on...
～いかんでは: depending on the situation, it may...
～いかんにかかわらず: regardless of how..., ...
